memory:
Plans a soon backyard BBQ with low-and-slow brisket (Killer Hogs rub, post oak; trim), ribs, pulled-pork sandwiches with slaw/pickles, burgers, hot dogs, grilled pineapple, mac and cheese and coleslaw. Mac is a favorite of user and friends. Owns a Weber gas grill. Favorite BBQ sauce is Kansas City M

REMINDERS (from a consistency check against the session):
- The user plans to smoke the brisket low-and-slow using Killer Hogs rub and post oak wood chips; S omits these details.
- The user plans to trim excess fat and silver skin from the brisket; S omits this.
- Sweet Baby Ray’s BBQ sauce is planned for the ribs; S omits this.
- The user currently loves Kansas City Masterpiece BBQ sauce, especially on ribs; S shortens its name to “Kansas City M” and weakens the stated preference.
- The pulled pork is planned for buns with coleslaw and pickles; S omits the buns and pickles.
- The user plans to try new BBQ recipes and experiment with sauces, toppings, and wood flavors; S omits this goal.
- The Weber gas grill is used for quick weeknight dinners; S mentions ownership but omits this use and preference.
- The user’s friend Emily brought grilled pineapple to the user’s birthday party; S omits this fact.
